decision: Select the editorial architecture for the first V1.1 experiment. The choice must preserve the accepted route and keep the base visit complete without optional content.

proposals.label: Socle + approfondissements
proposals.experience_model: One complete accessible base episode per stop, with optional deeper content only where it adds clear value.
proposals.lens_behavior: Optional extras are proposed per stop, without asking the visitor to choose a persistent profile.
proposals.why_discriminating: Lowest-complexity V1.1: preserves the current experience and proves optional depth before introducing a stronger multi-lens model.

proposals.label: Socle + lentilles transversales
proposals.experience_model: One complete base episode per stop plus a small stable set of named lenses that can be followed across several stops.
proposals.lens_behavior: The visitor explicitly pulls a lens when desired; a lens may recur across the route and may bridge to another lens, but is never required.
proposals.why_discriminating: Directly tests the review's idea that the same place can support several coherent readings without creating a recommendation engine.

proposals.label: Socle + lentilles + épopée inter-villes
proposals.experience_model: The same layered local visit as B, enriched by an optional narrative thread that can continue from Bordeaux to other cities and routes.
proposals.lens_behavior: Visitor-pulled lenses remain local; a separate optional saga thread connects selected episodes across cities.
proposals.why_discriminating: Tests the strongest product idea from the review: a city visit that is complete alone but can also belong to a wider journey such as Bordeaux → La Rochelle → Vendée → Orléans.
